rank_math_title: 8 Days Rwanda Safari: Gorillas, Chimps & Epic Bisoke Hike
rank_math_desc: 8 days Rwanda safari: chimps and the canopy walk in Nyungwe, Lake Kivu, a gorilla trek, the Mount Bisoke hike and golden monkeys. Permits and lodges included.
post_content: This 8 days Rwanda safari takes you through Nyungwe, Lake Kivu and Volcanoes National Park for chimps, gorillas, golden monkeys and the Mount Bisoke hike.
overview:
This 8 days Rwanda safari is built for active travellers. It combines chimpanzee trekking and the canopy walk in Nyungwe, two relaxing days on Lake Kivu, a mountain gorilla trek, the Mount Bisoke volcano hike and golden monkeys.

You travel in a private 4x4 with your own driver guide, following a natural loop from Kigali through the southwest, up the lakeshore and into the Virunga volcanoes.

Why choose this 8 days Rwanda safari?

Eight days lets you see Rwanda's three great primates without rushing, and it adds the country's most rewarding day hike. The Lake Kivu days in the middle give you a welcome break between treks.

  • Primates: chimpanzees, gorillas and golden monkeys.
  • Hiking: the Mount Bisoke crater lake at 3,711 metres.
  • Culture: tea picking, a coffee tour and the King's Palace.

What to expect on your 8 days Rwanda safari

After arrival, you tour Kigali and drive southwest to Nyungwe, stopping at the King's Palace Museum in Nyanza. Day three is a dawn chimpanzee trek and an afternoon on the canopy walkway.

On day four you try tea picking, then follow the scenic Congo-Nile road to Kibuye on Lake Kivu. Day five includes a boat trip to the islands, including Napoleon Island with its fruit bats, and a coffee washing station tour before heading to Musanze.

Day six is your gorilla trek and a visit to the Gorilla Guardians Village. Day seven is the Mount Bisoke hike, about four hours up to the crater lake. On day eight you trek golden monkeys and return to Kigali.

How fit do you need to be?

You should be comfortable hiking for several hours on steep, muddy ground. Bisoke is the most demanding day, so a porter and a steady pace are recommended.

Best time for an 8 days Rwanda safari

June to September and December to February give drier trails for the gorilla trek and the Bisoke climb, and better chimp sightings in Nyungwe. The trip runs all year with good rain gear.

Read our guide to gorilla trekking in Rwanda and golden monkey trekking in Rwanda. Prefer fewer hikes? See the Nyungwe and Lake Kivu tour. Forest facts are on Visit Rwanda's Nyungwe National Park page.

How much does the 8 days Rwanda safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: Is 8 days a good length for a Rwanda safari?
faq.a: Yes. Eight days lets you visit Nyungwe, Lake Kivu and Volcanoes National Park without rushing, with time for both primates and hiking.

faq.q: Can I hike Bisoke the day after gorilla trekking?
faq.a: Yes. Many travellers do. Bisoke is more demanding than most gorilla treks, so a porter and a steady pace are recommended.

faq.q: What is the coffee experience on Lake Kivu?
faq.a: You visit a local cooperative's washing station to see coffee cherries sorted, washed and dried, learn about roasting and finish with a fresh tasting.

faq.q: What is the best time for this 8-day Rwanda safari?
faq.a: June to September and December to February offer drier trails for gorilla trekking and hiking, though the trip runs all year.

faq.q: Does this 8 days Rwanda safari include Akagera?
faq.a: No. This route focuses on primates, hiking and Lake Kivu. We can swap a day or add two days for an Akagera game drive.

faq.q: How much is a gorilla permit in Rwanda?
faq.a: A gorilla permit costs USD 1,500 per person and is included in this package, along with the chimpanzee, golden monkey and Bisoke permits.

faq.q: What is the minimum age for this safari?
faq.a: Gorilla trekking is for visitors aged 15 and over. The minimum age for chimpanzee trekking is usually 12, which we confirm when you book.
